purpose: Make PARIS / STATION F a formal Project Zero sourcing territory with a Pre-Funding Edge bias: early cohorts, research-founder programmes and pre-company studios — not a general Paris startup-news feed. Candidates only: each becomes a configured watcher only after Mohamed's explicit Adopt click.
notes: Context: before this pack the Paris ecosystem had zero findings ever (coverage: PARTIAL — ZERO FINDINGS); the only France-specific discovery source was the national i-Lab laureate list, and the STATION F event watcher was configured with a parser (JSON-LD) the page does not support. Deliberately NOT included: stationf.co/startups (alumni / Future 40 showcase = post-institutional), HEC Incubator (mature MVP-stage only, no public roster), Entrepreneur First Paris (no public roster), general Paris tech news. Every URL below was opened on 2026-10-05.

sources.why_it_matters: Official STATION F feed with dated cards. Announces new Founders Program / F/ai / Fighters / Female Founders Fellowship batches (e.g. F/ai batch 2 kicked off 2026-09-23) — the earliest public roster of new campus teams, typically pre-seed.
sources.access_limitations: Mixes cohort announcements with partner / corporate program news (e.g. Samsung, TikTok programs) — leads need review; batch posts link to per-startup lists. Verified 2026-10-05: plain HTML, dated news cards.

sources.why_it_matters: Directory of campus programs (Founders Program, Fighters Program, HEC Incubator, F/ai for AI, Lab Quantique for quantum). A newly listed program = a new early-team intake channel inside STATION F.
sources.access_limitations: Program list only — no startup names; application links point to external forms. Verified 2026-10-05: plain HTML.

sources.why_it_matters: Four-month programme turning researchers' science into startups. Alumni listed by cohort include Alice & Bob, Pasqal, Aqemia and C12 — teams visible at the research-founder stage, well before their institutional rounds. Exactly the Pre-Funding Edge signal.
sources.access_limitations: The page does not state the programme's base city (run by Collective Ventures); alumni span France and the EU — confirm Paris presence per team. Verified 2026-10-05: plain HTML, projects grouped by cohort.

sources.source_name: Inria Startup Studio — portfolio (pre-company deeptech projects)
sources.why_it_matters: One-year support and funding programme for digital deeptech projects before incorporation (210+ projects selected since 2019, 75 incorporated). Projects are listed with year and Inria centre — Paris and Saclay are filters on the page.
sources.access_limitations: National portfolio (all 9 Inria centres): Paris / Saclay projects must be picked out by their centre label; non-Paris projects also appear. The main inria.fr page refused automated access (the portfolio site did not). Verified 2026-10-05: plain HTML with year and centre filters.
